properties.Observation: There are large trees at some places on both sides of the bank. But banks are eroded. Too much water flows in rainy season. In some places, small amounts of garbage have been dumped into streams, and in some places, reserved lands are being misused
properties.Description:
Paving available stone in the river banks and Planting trees

Dry rubble packing (with locally found rubble, size over 225mm )-Along the river banks

Vegetative cover improving around the river bank with Areca nut seedling in 1.5m x 1.5m grid, Kumbuk/ Me
